## R has functions!!!!

To have fun (ah ah)

```{r}
paste("Hello", "Lara")

paste("Hello", "Lara", sep = "")

1:10

paste("Variable", 1:10)
paste("Variable", 1:10, ";hello Lara again")
paste("Variable",c(1:10)*3,";hello Lara again")

## if I want to put together variable, numbers from  1 to 10 multiplied by three, and greet our Lara again
paste("Variable", 
      (c(1:10) * 3), 
      ";hello Lara again")

Sys.getenv("USER")
```

## Processing and inspecting

```{r}
head(penguins)

tail(penguins)

dim(penguins)

nrow(penguins)
ncol(penguins)

names(penguins)
rownames(penguins)

summary(penguins)

dplyr::glimpse(penguins)
```

## Subsetting!

```{r}
penguins$species

penguins[,1]
```


working with the penguins!!

```{r}
table(penguins$species)
table(penguins$species, penguins$island)
table(penguins$species, penguins$island, penguins$sex)

unique(penguins$island)
levels(penguins$island)

levels(penguins$sex)

is.na(penguins)

knitr::kable(penguins)
```

```{r}
head(penguins_raw)
head(penguins)

penguins |> dim()
```

```{r}
dirty_penguins <- penguins_raw

dirty_penguins$`Body Mass (g)`[42] <- -999 
dirty_penguins$Sex[6] <- "MALE "
dirty_penguins$Comments[4] <- ""

saveRDS(dirty_penguins, "datasets/dirty_penguins.RDS")

dplyr::glimpse(dirty_penguins)
summary(dirty_penguins)

unique(dirty_penguins$Sex)
```


back to raw penguins!

```{r}
penguins_raw$Sex
penguins_raw$Species

penguins$species

penguins_raw$`Sample Number`

colnames(penguins)

colnames(penguins_raw)

clean_names(penguins_raw) |> names()
names(penguins_raw)
names(penguins)
```



## Day2 but it is Day1

```{r}
#| error: true
 
penguins_raw

my_penguins <- penguins_raw

my_penguins$body_mass_kg <- my_penguins$`Body Mass (g)`/1000
hist(my_penguins$body_mass_kg)

my_penguins$Body Mass (g)

summary(my_penguins)

my_penguins$z_bodymass <- scale(my_penguins$body_mass_kg)

head(my_penguins$z_bodymass)
hist(my_penguins$z_bodymass, breaks = 20)
hist(my_penguins$body_mass_kg, breaks = 20)

my_penguins$mass_class <- cut(my_penguins$body_mass_kg, breaks = 3)
table(my_penguins$mass_class)
?cut

cut(my_penguins$body_mass_kg, breaks = 4)

janitor::clean_names(my_penguins)

my_penguins$`Body Mass (g)`

head(my_penguins)


my_penguins$Comments

my_penguins$my_comments <- c(1,2)
my_penguins$my_comments <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,0)

my_penguins$my_comments_v2 <- c(1,2,3,4)

my_penguins$my_comments_v2 <- NULL

```
